title: Mini Data Science Framework
description: Built a DataFrame class in Java with linked lists and binary search, plus a generic hash table with collision handling and dynamic resizing. Created Series and DataFrame structures supporting indexing and column operations (UCSD DSC 30).

title: TV Sitcom Data Analysis
description: Analyzed Friends episode, script, and sentiment datasets (7k+ lines, 10 seasons) using Python in Jupyter Notebook. Used bootstrapping and hypothesis testing on directors' IMDb ratings, analyzed gender balance across 6,500+ lines, and built a 2-gram Markov title generator (UCSD DSC 10).
